provenance.note: Revolvers with a 3 in barrel and pistols that fit the 180 x 140 x 40 mm box (C.6E.1). The course runs at 15, 10 and 7 m, the record holds the longest distance. The revolver barrel length is stated as exactly 3 in, so no maximum is set. Any bullet shape except wadcutter is allowed.
